name: Heroes of Might and Magic II
what: Lead heroes across a fantasy map and fight turn-based battles.

fanProjects.name: fheroes2
fanProjects.what: Fans rebuilt the 1996 game so it runs on today's computers and phones. The free demo's files are enough to try it.
howToPlay: Download fheroes2 from its GitHub page.
Use the files from your own copy (GOG), or the free demo to try it.

lovedFeatures: Move heroes across a map, one turn at a time
